SQL: استعلام.text:
```sql
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING SUM(o.total) > 1000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;
```

Here is the SQL query you need:

```sql
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) as total_orders
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING SUM(o.total) > 1000
ORDER BY total_orders DESC;
```
This query will return the names of customers along with their total orders from the 'customers' table and only those who have ordered more than 1000 items, sorted in descending order by the number of orders.
